description.narrative: Allied Chemicals Share Company (Allied) is Ethiopia's largest domestic manufacturer of industrial chemicals, headquartered in Addis Ababa with three manufacturing facilities in Ethiopia. Founded in 2008, the company produces 18 chemical and mineral products and serves over 1,300 customers across Ethiopia, including large FMCG manufacturers and beverage companies. The Project involves the construction and commissioning of a greenfield NPK/NPS fertilizer blending plant in Adama, Ethiopia the first privately owned compound fertilizer facility in the country. IFC is providing a financing package of up to US$17 million, comprising an IFC A Loan of US$11 million structured as a Local Currency Linked Loan in Ethiopian Birr and supported by an IDA-PSW Blended Finance Facility swap subsidy, and US$6 million mobilized from parallel lenders.

The development impact is provided through: Increasing value addition and job creation by expanding domestic fertilizer production, expanding the domestic supply-chain to include more upstream steps; Increasing access and affordability of a critical agricultural input in a market with substantial failures; Increasing the competitiveness of Ethiopia's agricultural sector, by establishing Ethiopia's first fertilizer blending facility, reducing vulnerability to external shocks, and boosting agricultural productivity through more intensive fertilizer use.
